newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo's JAT to start flights to Amman, Beirut, Cairo.
newsitem.headline: Yugo's JAT to start flights to Amman, Beirut, Cairo.

text.p: Yugoslavia's flag carrier Yugoslovenski Aerotransport (JAT) said on Thursday it will re-start flights to Amman, Beirut and Cairo in August.
Flights to Amman and Beirut will start on August 9 and to Cairo via Larnaca on August 15, the company said in a news release faxed to Reuters.
Renewing flights with Jordan, Lebanon and Egypt, JAT will increase the number of regular international flights to 35 from the current 32.
JAT established the air link with the three destinations in 1955, but because of war-related international sanctions, flights were halted in May 1992.
JAT plans to fly to Amman and Beirut once a week departing Saturday evenings. Return flights will be on Sunday mornings.
Departure flight to Cairo via Larnaca will be on Friday late afternoons and return flight from Cairo on Saturday mornings. -- Gordana Kukic, Belgrade Newsroom +381 11 311 4254
